meta.name: pricing-packaging-tracker
meta.description: Track competitor pricing and packaging as a diffable time series. Use when monitoring tiers, gates, limits, and price moves on a monthly or quarterly cadence.

copy.tagline: 追踪竞品定价与套餐变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期监控竞品价格和套餐调整。
copy.tagline_en: Track competitor pricing and packaging changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly monitor competitor pricing and packaging changes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按固定格式抓取竞争对手的定价页面，并与上次记录对比，输出一份只显示变化的报告，包括价格、功能门槛、套餐结构等变动。
howto.when: 当你要求追踪特定竞争对手的定价和套餐，或询问本季度是否有竞品调整定价时触发。

say.text: 追踪竞品A和竞品B的定价变化，上次记录在附件里。
say.note: Claude 会对比并输出变化报告。

say.text: 本季度有没有竞品调整了套餐结构？
say.note: Claude 会检查上次记录并报告变动。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude captures competitor pricing pages into a stable schema, diffs against the prior capture, and outputs a report of changes only — tier changes, price moves, feature-gate shifts, and packaging restructures with URLs and dates.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to track specific competitors' pricing and packaging, or inquire about pricing changes in the current quarter.

say_en.text: Track pricing changes for Competitor A and Competitor B, prior capture attached.
say_en.note: Claude will diff and output a change report.

say_en.text: Did any competitor change their packaging this quarter?
say_en.note: Claude will check the last capture and report changes.
